environment.description: Same application deployed in a private subnet behind an internal Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB target group is registered in a VPC with no internet gateway or NAT gateway attached. Ingress is controlled by a security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) that permits TCP/443 only from source prefix list pl-0dc7e3af2 which resolves to three internal CIDR blocks: 10.128.0.0/16 (corporate office egress), 172.16.200.0/22 (VPN concentrator pool), and 192.168.50.0/24 (CI/CD runner subnet). The VPC has no peering connections, no Transit Gateway attachments beyond the corporate TGW (tgw-04a8b1ce) which only routes the three listed CIDRs. DNS resolution for the ALB is via private hosted zone (not publicly resolvable). There is no public IP assigned to the instance, no Elastic IP, and the subnet route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route.
